projects.name: AgroValue
implemented_features: AGMARKNET/OGD mandi-data workflow, validation, and time-series feature engineering.
Seasonal Naive and SARIMAX baseline comparison.
Chronological holdout evaluation using MAE, RMSE, and sMAPE.
experiments: Comparing forecasting baselines on chronological holdout data.
planned_features: Publish the exact holdout window, dataset filters, baseline-vs-model result table, and screenshots/dashboard recording.
measured_results: Evaluation metrics are defined; numerical scores and forecast-impact claims are not published here.
limitations: Forecast performance depends on commodity/market selection, date range, source-data gaps, and regime changes.
projects.evidence_status: Workflow and evaluation approach are described; a reproducible numerical result table remains to be added.

projects.name: Q-Learning on FrozenLake

experiments: Learning behaviour under the selected environment and training settings.
planned_features: Publish configuration, seed policy, training episode count, evaluation episode count, and observed success rates.
measured_results: No particular success-rate score is published without a reproducible run record.
limitations: Results vary with environment settings, stochasticity, hyperparameters, and evaluation episodes.
projects.evidence_status: Implementation workflow described; numerical run evidence has not yet been published in the case study.
